description: This PHP class defines the AOR_Chart class for a CRM module, including properties for chart configurations, methods for generating different types of charts (bar, pie, line, radar, etc.), data processing, and rendering HTML/JavaScript code to display charts using various charting libraries.

classes.name: AOR_Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart entity in SuiteCRM, with capabilities to generate and render various types of charts (bar, pie, line, radar, etc.) based on report data. Contains configuration properties, data processing methods, and rendering functions.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Saves or updates lines/charts related to a report based on posted data, creating or updating chart beans and deleting removed ones.

methods.name: getValidChartTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of valid chart types supported by the class.

methods.name: getColour
methods.description: Generates a color (main and highlight) based on a seed string; can return as hex or RGB array.

methods.name: buildChartImage
methods.description: Builds a chart image using pChart library, returning as base64 Data URI or raw binary depending on parameter.

methods.name: buildChartHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for various chart types, integrating with Chart.js or other libraries, and embedding the chart image or canvas.

methods.name: buildChartHTMLPChart
methods.description: Builds HTML for PChart chart image with image map integration.

methods.name: getShortenedLabel
methods.description: Shortens labels longer than a specified maximum size by adding ellipsis.

methods.name: getRGraphGroupedBarChartData
methods.description: Processes report data to generate grouped or stacked bar chart data.

methods.name: getRGraphBarChartData
methods.description: Extracts label, data, and tooltip arrays for RGraph bar charts from report data.

methods.name: getBarChartData
methods.description: Prepares dataset for Chart.js bar chart.

methods.name: getLineChartData
methods.description: Prepares dataset for Chart.js line chart.

methods.name: getRGraphGroupedBarChart
methods.description: Generates RGraph JavaScript code to render grouped or stacked bar charts.

methods.name: getRGraphBarChart
methods.description: Generates RGraph JavaScript code to render a bar chart.

methods.name: getRGraphRadarChart
methods.description: Generates RGraph code for a radar chart.

methods.name: getRGraphPieChart
methods.description: Generates RGraph pie chart code.

methods.name: getRGraphLineChart
methods.description: Generates RGraph line chart code.

methods.name: buildChartHTMLChartJS
methods.description: Creates HTML and JavaScript code to render charts using Chart.js based on report data.

methods.name: buildChartHTMLRGraph
methods.description: Builds HTML/JavaScript for RGraph charts, including data processing and rendering scripts.

methods.name: getRadarChartData
methods.description: Prepares data array for radar charts.

methods.name: getRadarChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for radar charts.

methods.name: getPieChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for pie charts.

methods.name: getPieChartData
methods.description: Prepares data array for pie charts, including labels, values, and colors.
